schoolCardHelp: Select the school used for your WebUntis account.
credentialHelp: Create or manage login credentials in ioBroker Settings → Credentials.
refreshIntervalsCardHelp: Enter whole minutes within each interval's allowed range. Missing or invalid values use the default intervals.

UNSUPPORTED_LOGIN: This school login method is not supported
